verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say users can talk to its agents in natural language: message them in updates or @mention them to kick off real work. Users can also describe a workflow in their own words to create an agent, turn words into work apps with monday vibe, and work from Claude or ChatGPT through the monday MCP. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which product operations natural-language commands can perform, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Talk to agents like teammates. Message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work — replies, statuses, and follow-ups included.
Describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent in minutes.
Before coding, try turning words into work apps using monday vibe.
Work with tools like Claude, Copilot, and ChatGPT through official integrations or the monday MCP
